description:
Xebia is a global AI-first, digital transformation, and engineering partner. With over 25 years of experience and a team of 5,000 professionals across 16 countries, we help organizations design and build scalable products, platforms, and data-driven solutions. 

We specialize in Artificial Intelligence, Data and Cloud, Intelligent Automation, and Digital Products, combining deep technical expertise with a strong focus on engineering excellence and a people-first culture.  

In the CEE region, we’re a team of nearly 1,000 experts delivering modern applications, data platforms, and AI solutions for clients such as McLaren, Aviva, Deloitte, Spotify, Disney, ING, UPS, Tesco, Truecaller, AllSaints, Volotea, Schmitz Cargobull, Allegro, InPost, and many, many more. We work with leading technologies including AWS, Azure, GCP, Databricks, and Snowflake, and combine strong engineering culture with a consulting mindset and a continuous focus on growth and knowledge sharing. 

 

You will be:

  • prepare and execute test cases for backend and integration scenarios,
  • perform API testing, including file generation, event flows and Bulk API round-trips,
  • test integrations between Salesforce and other backend systems,
  • validate integrations with SEDA, Elliot and an AKS-based integration system,
  • prepare and maintain test data,
  • support test environment maintenance and troubleshooting,
  • analyze test results and report defects,
  • collaborate with developers, business analysts and other QA engineers in a distributed team.

Your profile:

  • hands-on experience in backend, API or integration testing,
  • practical experience with API testing and integration test scenarios,
  • experience preparing test cases and maintaining test data,
  • understanding of backend event flows and system integrations,
  • experience testing integrations with Salesforce or similar enterprise platforms,
  • good understanding of QA processes and testing methodologies,
  • ability to investigate issues across integrated systems and communicate findings clearly,
  • Italian at B2+ level,
  • good English communication skills,
  • willingness to work from Milan 2–3 days per quarter.

Nice to have:

  • experience with Salesforce integrations,
  • experience with Bulk API or similar APIs,
  • familiarity with SEDA,
  • familiarity with Elliot,
  • experience with AKS or other Kubernetes-based integration environments.

Recruitment Process:

CV review – HR call – Interview – Client Interview – Decision
